gate-runner.description: Runs the gate (phpcs, phpstan, drush cr, config status) on the changed files and returns pass/fail with only the error lines and the [VERIFIED] evidence strings. Use via /gate or after each implementation block.

gate.description: Run the gate (phpcs, phpstan, drush cr, config status) and get only pass/fail + error lines (gate-runner). Usage: /gate [paths]
